description: Team Stellarian s a dedicated solo-driven tech and innovation initiative passionate about bridging the gap between complex space science and immersive digital storytelling. Driven by a deep curiosity for the cosmos and modern web architecture, CodeEx specializes in transforming raw archival data into interactive, high-impact web experiences that educate and inspire the next generation of space explorers."Silent Sentinels: Echoes of Space Exploration"—a web museum.
